# ankra_registry_project (Resource)

An extra project on the Ankra image registry. A robot account is bound to one project, so a project is how a login is limited to part of what the organisation publishes. The counterpart of `ankra registry projects create` and `ankra registry projects delete`. The platform refuses to delete a project that still holds repositories or has robots bound to it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ankra_registry_project" "ci" {
  name = "ci-images"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name the project is addressed by. Changing it replaces the project.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the project was created. A project of the same name created later is a different project: Terraform then treats this one as gone instead of adopting it.
- `host` (String) Registry host images are pushed to.
- `id` (String) The project name.
- `project` (String) The project's name on the registry: the path segment images are pushed under.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Registry projects are imported by name.
terraform import ankra_registry_project.ci ci-images
```
